task: Exploratory next-observation up classification with stock, market and sector ETF context
features: Original 8 stock features; stock momentum 20/60 observations; each ETF return over 1/5/20 observations and 20-observation mean absolute return; stock 5-observation return minus SPY 5-observation return. All information available only after the day's close.
models: Original-feature logistic control; context logistic; context 16-unit sigmoid neural network, 20 epochs, seed 42; mature XGBoost if runtime permits.
selection: Prior-year validation log loss chooses XGBoost rounds and the best single context model. Then refit on all pre-test labels. No test-driven retries or threshold optimization. Classification threshold fixed at .5.
evaluation: Identical aligned rows for all baselines and models. Primary log loss; accuracy, balanced accuracy, Brier and AUC secondary; daily paired block-bootstrap gain intervals (5/10/20 session blocks).
scope: Previously inspected retrospective dataset, convenience stocks and retrospectively adjusted ETF data; no new confirmatory holdout, trading strategy or profitability claim. No economic sector membership inference is made from the ETF features.
